about_the_game:
The Next Generation of Naval Combat

Command the most advanced nuclear-powered submarines in the world. Modern Naval Warfare is the ultimate tactical simulation, offering unparalleled depth in graphics, physics, and authentic combat systems. From the pressure-crushed depths of the ocean to the high-stakes politics of the South China Sea, every bolt, frequency, and sonar ping is simulated with uncompromising detail.

Unrivaled Visual & Atmospheric Fidelity Experience a world built on real-world GIS data. The simulation's physically-based rendering (PBR) and world lighting create a breathtaking environment, from the curvature of the Earth at high altitudes to the shimmering caustics and reflections on the ocean surface.

  • Volumetric Clouds & Dynamic Weather: Navigate through GIS-assisted weather conditions and a multi-layered spectral wave system.

  • Authentic Interiors: Explore accurate 3D representations of the Virginia class (Blocks I-IV) CIC with fully clickable, feature-complete control stations.

  • Living World: Engage with digital twins of modern military and civilian platforms, including dynamic civilian traffic assisted by GIS-AIS data.

Advanced Acoustic & Physics Simulation In the silent service, sound is your only sight. Our 3D sound propagation model calculates transients, flow noise, and individual component sounds (engines, pumps, propellers) in real-time.

  • Real-time Signal Analysis: Utilize FFT analysis for Narrowband, LOFAR, and DEMON applications, modulated by specific sonar array characteristics.

  • Physical Realism: Every object follows real-time hydrodynamic and hydrostatic calculations. Weapons movement, explosions, and even material reactions to underwater pressure are physics-based.

  • Damage Control: Face hi-fidelity damage modeling and volumetric flooding based on true shipbuilding concepts like permeability.

Sophisticated Systems & Weaponry Take control of a wide spectrum of military-standard sensors, including RADAR, SONAR, and EO/IR.

  • Electronic Warfare: Experience RF signal propagation affected by wavelength, line-of-sight, and antenna configuration.

  • Lethal Arsenal: Deploy torpedoes, multi-stage missiles (with individual stage envelopes), and mines.

  • Countermeasures: Defend your boat with noisemakers, sonar decoys, chaff, and flares.

  • Navigation: Use INS, GPS/GNSS, Tercom, and DSMAC for precision strikes.

Step into the role of various crew members with native-language station interfaces:

  • Pilot Station: Control depth, speed, course, trimming, and masts.

  • SONAR Station: Manage Broadband, Narrowband, Active Intercept, and Tactical Decision Aid.

  • Fire Control: Utilize advanced TMA (Target Motion Analysis) with interactive rulers and mission planners for Harpoon and TLAM missiles.

  • ESM & RADAR: Intercept threats and monitor AIS signals to maintain situational awareness.

Whether you are a lone wolf or part of a strike group, the world is your battlespace.

  • The Technothriller Campaign: A massive 18-mission campaign set in the South China Sea.

  • Diverse Operations: Engage in Anti-Submarine Warfare (ASW), convoy hunts, special forces insertion, and espionage.

  • Training & Editor: Learn the ropes with a 3-mission training sequence or create your own challenges with the built-in quick mission editor.
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel or AMD 3.0 Ghz+ with 4 cores (e.g. Intel Core i5-6600 or AMD Ryzen 3 2200G)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Discreet GPU with 4 GB (e.g. Nvidia GTX 1650 Super or AMD RX 5600 XT)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
requirements_recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel or AMD 4.0 Ghz+ with 8+ cores (e.g. Intel Core i7-10700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X)
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Discreet GPU with 8 GB + (e.g. Nvidia RTX 4070 or AMD RX 9070 XT)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
